answers: No. The text says do not move to Postgres now; plan the move before adding the second app server.
A second app server makes the move necessary. Lock errors or slow writes that continue after tuning, needing Postgres-only features, or needing failover also trigger it.
Running Postgres takes more operations work: backups, upgrades, vacuum, and connection limits. It also uses 1 to 2 GB of RAM on an 8 GB VPS.
